description: Bangladeshi Traffic Flow Dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Mohammad Manzurul Islam, Mohammad Rifat Ahmmad Rashid (East West University). In Bangladesh, general public compliance with traffic regulations is notably low. This dataset aims to analyze the traffic flow patterns in Dhaka, focusing on both vehicular movement and pedestrian activities. Data were gathered from four different locations: Shapla Chattar, Arambag, Bashabo, and Abul Hotel. Coverage: national (BD); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
